correctness.rationale: PASS: For the 12-vertex 30-edge five-regular icosahedral graph, independent enumeration of 4096 vertex subsets yields 984 forest faces including empty, by cardinality (1,12,66,200,345,300,60). Independent vertex-toggle matching has exactly 472 pairs and 40 critical four-simplices (with empty matched to a vertex); the entire 3984-arrow Hasse orientation topologically sorts, hence Forman gives a point plus 40 four-cells, integrally ∨40S4. Independently enumerated all 120 graph automorphisms by graph isomorphism (A5×C2), and computed signed fixed-face Lefschetz values by rotation classes (order1:40, 2:-4, 3:1, 5:0) and antipode coset (-10,2,-1,0), as stated. Rational A5 character table gives the even V4+V5+V6 (15 dimensions) and odd 2V4+V5+2V6 (25 dimensions), rotation invariants zero.
